name: @equin/plugin-framework-tooling-boundaries-runtime-exception
description: The boundary config's runtimeExceptions entry grammar ("<zone>.<plugin id>.<folder> -> <zone>.<plugin id>.<folder>"): parseRuntimeException splits one into its two sides. A leaf with no imports, so the plugin-reference locator reads the entries through the checker's own grammar without loading the checker — its file scan's record key follows this module, not the boundaries barrel.
